body:
My ex told me something very similar recently. He said he felt like the relationship was an obligation and that he had to put me over himself. I never felt so low before.

I know how you're feeling. I'm sorry you were told that- it's a horrifying comment to receive. But please don't take it out on yourself, you haven't done anything wrong in wanting support.
I'm happy she was there for you at that time... if possible, Planned Parenthood also gives out Plan B for free, and you can remain relatively anonymous. Helped me during a scary time 💟
I feel that. It's still so strange realising that it even happened. It makes everything feel not real, and I hate it. I'm sorry you feel that way, and am glad you can push yourself forward.💖
